shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 2 on the number line on the left with the mark at the origin on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed set excludes 2 at its upper bound. Right image: The displayed function has no value at x=0.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray. On the right, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=0.
